title: Parsley Health comparison table
description: A centred eyebrow and light serif title over a calm comparison table: a wide column of row labels, three rival columns and the company's own column filled in mint, each row a thin rule apart, with thin check and cross marks or short medium-weight words. On phones the label column and the third rival drop out and each label sits small at the top of the mint cell.
notes: a cell value of true draws a check, false a cross, and text shows as a word or two; phones show the first two rivals
